# flodlol.dev

> Personal portfolio of Jonas Meuleman, also known online as flodlol.

Jonas is an Industrial Engineering student at KU Leuven and a software developer who builds web applications and developer tools.

## Main sections

- [Current and past projects](https://flodlol.dev/#current-projects)
- [Learning timeline](https://flodlol.dev/#timeline)
- [Contact information](https://flodlol.dev/#contact)
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/flodlol)

## Featured projects

- [Study-Track](https://study-track.app): a study tracking and academic planning application.
- [Hand-Outs](https://hand-outs.com): a tool that turns lecture-slide PDFs into printable handouts.
- [Statics NVM](https://sterkteleer.flodlol.dev): an educational statics solver with worked N, V, and M diagrams.
